comments.value:
Let's swap this back to Open. That doesn't mean anything other than "leaving stuff as under review for almost a year seems annoying". It makes people think that we're working on it *right now* and it is on the way out soon. It isn't.
...but **we're still considering this and it is still a good idea.** I just want Custom Statuses from Canny, thank you very much! 😡 Would love to set things as "Under Consideration" or "Tracked Internally". 
Anyways, well aware that this could be useful. Personally, I'm worried about attaching *even more* functionality to the friend state of a user. I might be wrong on that? Just a thought.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: not really wrong.
If added it will be better i think in the long run

agree
loaded in a 30+ people world and my friend loaded last
this is a really good idea and i’d like to see it happen
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: a friend is the most likely person in a wold a vrc user will talk to, so they should be the first person loaded in.
After friends have loaded the users nearest to the player should load in before users farther from the player. Alternatively don't load friends first and just do it based on distance.

I don't really need to see my friend's avatars before anyone else's so long as their nameplate comes up quickly (which it already does). I mean, it's a nice feature to have but if it's going to put a strain on the  friends functionality state, it's probably less important than other features to me.
Are you sure this is complete? The patch notes video said it loaded smallest avatars first, not friends first.
@{62dfd2db51871f468ad0c324|full_name}: It loads smallest avatars first by default but gives you the option to add "shown first" and "friends first" to the list of prioritizations.
@{63882dc1f272550ad4b6b553|full_name}: Oh, sweet. Weird that they didn't mention that in the video.

details: Set VRChat model loading to prioritize loading avatar model assets of 'Friend'ed users before loading non-Friend users. VRChat currently loads models randomly, often loading friends models after other people.
title: "Friends First" Model Priority Loading
